title: WATCH: How to register for the 2028 elections
summary: MANILA, Philippines — INQUIRER.net multimedia reporter Chelsy Perez guides voters through the process of getting registered with the Commission on Elections for the 2018 national and local elections.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — INQUIRER.net multimedia reporter Chelsy Perez guides voters through the process of getting registered with the Commission on Elections for the 2018 national and local elections. Registration runs from Nov. 10 to July 30, 2027. /atm
